tools.purpose: Map the six stages of a browser signing chain from the bundle itself - collect, order, secret, digest, attach, replay guard - and report whether the four positional stages already ascend, plus the field literals inside the ordering region, since that set is the boundary the server can enforce.
tools.expect: a stage table with positional flag, hit counts, first offset and matched tokens; the ordering verdict; the candidate field list; and a reading that names the missing stage

tools.purpose: Given one captured request and a candidate secret, find which join, case and hash reproduce the observed signature value.
tools.expect: match table (algorithm, recipe, pre-image length) or the ordered list of reasons a request does not reproduce

notes: Two directions on the same chain: sign_chain_scan reads the bundle statically and never executes it, sign_chain_probe replays one captured request offline against enumerated constructions. Offsets from the scan are byte offsets into the decoded text. A missing stage is missing from this file - a fetched module or a WebAssembly digest is the usual reason. Several probe recipes can collapse to one pre-image on a given input, so that report counts distinct pre-images rather than recipes; its exit code 1 means no construction matched.
